## Usage

Use the exports from the installed entry file:

```tsx
import { Fieldwork } from "@/components/lazy-ui/templates/fieldwork"

export default function Page() {
  return <Fieldwork />
}
```

## Setup notes

Requires React and Tailwind CSS 4. Includes the listening-station block, signal dial, and interference shader. Navigation links scroll to sections within the template. The signal lab is visual only and does not play audio.
